scope: Read-only exact Git source and APK identity audit; no tests, builds, CI polls, staging, commits, source edits or remote mutations.

previous_identity_manifest.scope: Historical 2be-to-3954 Solar / 5e-to-3954 all-modules identity; old candidate hashes are historical.

method.content: git cat-file --batch; full content SHA-256 for every recorded blob, including binary evidence
method.comparison: Exact path/mode/kind/blob identity plus SHA-256; no whitespace normalization or tolerant comparison
method.module_coverage: Whole module trees include tests/build files wherever listed; Solar production is app/src/main plus its four Gradle configuration files. All changed files elsewhere are listed separately.
method.apk: Current file SHA-256 compared with original build-verification record; shader asset extracted from each archive; selected compiled production source hashes compared with final Git blobs.

attribution_limits: Exact source identity does not move an earlier CI run to a new commit or assert that the final CI run passed.
All non-Solar module trees including their tests/build inputs are unchanged 3954-to-b9ec; historical 5e-to-3954 equality is retained separately.
Solar production changed two files: full-catalogue fragment evaluation and its honest status label. Old a32e/5e15 APKs are historical; current APKs are c01b/8000.
Both current APK builds used 3954 plus two frozen overlays. All 62 snapshot entries now exactly match b9ec, including 60 production/build inputs and 2 reused test source files.
Signature checks are reused only after APK byte identity with their verification reports. No new physical-device or emulator validation is claimed.
